newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bad weather drives Yeltsin back to Moscow - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather drives Yeltsin back to Moscow - Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has decided to interrupt his Black Sea holiday and return early to Moscow on Wednesday because of bad weather, his spokesman said.
"His departure is linked to just one circumstance -- bad weather," Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a Russian reporter who had asked if the Kremlin leader's return could be linked to poor health.
Yeltsin, who underwent heart surgery last November, had been shown wearing a sweater for a meeting in the Black Sea resort of Sochi earlier on Wednesday with Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov.

Television pictures showed sunny weather in Sochi but Yastrzhembsky said Yeltsin had decided on Monday to return. "The president stuck to his decision even though the weather in Sochi is improving a little," he said.

An official from the Meteorological Centre said the temperature in Sochi was around 18 degrees Celsius (64 Fahrenheit). But she said there could be cloud and it had been raining there over the past few days.
A Kremlin spokesman in Moscow said Yeltsin would return to his Gorky-9 residence west of Moscow on Wednesday evening.
Yeltsin met Kulikov to discuss tensions in southern Russia after a series of violent incidents there which the minister has said could get out of control.
The president also met First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov to discuss the latest anti-corruption campaign and tighter state control on the alcohol market.
